about: Where each place sits, shapes first (CONTEXT.md "outside shell", "inside place"): `within` names the outside place or shell holding a place, `from` the data it was read from; a place not listed is an outside place of its own. `shells` are outside shells that are no place of their own yet (no plan): their inside places are. `parts` are parts of an outside place's own outside (`of`), drawn in its concept (`as`) and grouped under it, no place of their own to the creator; their stage rows still run as places until the route folds them in. Derived by hand from the plans on 2026-10-20 (#42); no plan has a shell split yet (#16), which replaces this once it does. Read by the cockpit (score/dashboard/state/local.py) and the concept review's wording (score/review/concepts.py: an outside place's or shell's first draw names the inside places listed under it), never by a stage.
